criteria.description: When fetch rejects during an add (wasAdded === true), toggleFavourite must remove productId from favouriteIds, restoring the pre-toggle state.
criteria.evidence: FavouritesContext.tsx lines 75-84: catch block calls setFavouriteIds with functional updater; when wasAdded===true it calls next.delete(productId). tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx: 4/4 tests passed (vitest run output: '✓ tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx (4 tests) 250ms').

criteria.description: When fetch rejects during a remove (wasAdded === false), toggleFavourite must re-add productId to favouriteIds, restoring the pre-toggle state.
criteria.evidence: FavouritesContext.tsx lines 75-84: catch block calls setFavouriteIds with functional updater; when wasAdded===false it calls next.add(productId). tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx: 4/4 tests passed (vitest run output: '✓ tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx (4 tests) 250ms').

criteria.description: The revert in the catch block must use a functional updater (setFavouriteIds(prev => ...)) rather than capturing the entire favouriteIds Set at call time.
criteria.evidence: FavouritesContext.tsx lines 76-84: catch block uses 'setFavouriteIds((prev) => { const next = new Set(prev); if (wasAdded) { next.delete(productId); } else { next.add(productId); } return next; })' — a functional updater taking prev as parameter, never constructing a literal Set from a closure-captured variable. No captured favouriteIds variable is used in the catch block.

criteria.description: toggleFavourite must call setPendingIds to add productId before the fetch call, so that isPending(productId) returns true while the request is in flight.
criteria.evidence: FavouritesContext.tsx line 61: 'setPendingIds((prev) => new Set(prev).add(productId));' appears before the try block (which contains the fetch calls at lines 66 and 72). tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx: 4/4 tests passed.

criteria.description: toggleFavourite must call setPendingIds to remove productId in a finally block, so that isPending(productId) returns false once the request completes.
criteria.evidence: FavouritesContext.tsx lines 86-91: 'finally { setPendingIds((prev) => { const next = new Set(prev); next.delete(productId); return next; }); }' — a finally block with functional updater removing productId. The cleanup does NOT appear in try or catch branches; it is only in finally.

criteria.description: While toggleFavourite is in flight for productId, FavouriteButton for that product must be rendered as disabled.
criteria.evidence: FavouriteButton.tsx line 10-18: 'const pending = isPending(productId);' and '<button ... disabled={pending}>'. Requirement 4 is met (setPendingIds adds before fetch), so isPending returns true in-flight and disabled={pending} disables the button. tests/favouriteRevert.test.tsx: 4/4 tests passed.
